in_sanskrit.name: सुबीर
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Subir is derived from the Sanskrit word 'subhra', which means 'dawn' or 'early morning'. It is often used to describe the beautiful and serene atmosphere of the early morning hours.

in_hindi.name: सुबिर
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name Subir in Hindi is derived from the Sanskrit word 'subhra', which means 'dawn'. It can also be translated to mean 'associated with the sun'. The name is often used to describe the beauty and serenity of the early morning hours.

in_marathi.name: Subir
in_marathi.long_meaning: Subir हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A name derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Subhra’, meaning ‘dawn’ or ‘early morning’. Subir is a name that evokes feelings of hope, renewal, and the promise of a new beginning. It is a name that is deeply connected to the natural world, and is often given to children born at the break of dawn.
